title: Chloe reads the stack
venue: the coast community-college paper, Newport · the laundromat digest
source: lore/drift_wood/_THE_COMPLETE_RUN.md (1999–2000 · deepening xix · the daily filled)
logline: Chloe borrows the whole stack of digests from the laundromat's back shelf — the owner kept one of each — and reads them on her porch in order. Wood drives past twice. The second time she holds one up without looking: the pear. She keeps that one.

panels.composition: Chloe's porch. CHLOE on the steps with a stack of digests, forty, reading in order. The Discman off.

image.prompt: a young woman on porch steps reading through a tall stack of small photocopied booklets in order, headphones off, black and white, no words

panels.composition: The Datsun passing. WOOD, forward. BARNABY looking back.

image.prompt: a small car passing a house where a young woman reads on the porch, the driver looking ahead and a dog looking back, black and white, no words

panels.composition: The second pass, the other direction. Chloe holding one digest up over her head without looking: the pear cover.

image.prompt: a young woman on a porch holding a small booklet up over her head without looking as a car passes, black and white, no words

panels.composition: The pear cover in her hand. The rest of the stack beside her. She keeps that one. The strip sees her put it in the cardigan pocket.

image.prompt: close on a young woman slipping a small booklet with a pear on its cover into a cardigan pocket, black and white, no words

art.line: brush-pen, committed; black and white; xerox

notes: Forty in order. She keeps the pear. The owner kept one of each: the archive begins with her.
